title: Modern Nashville Getaway
description:
Experience Nashville from this spacious home ideally located near top attractions. Just a short drive to Marathon Village, Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, and The Gulch, you'll be perfectly positioned for easy city exploration. Relax in comfort with modern amenities, stylish interiors, and a private backyard ideal for unwinding in the Tennessee sunshine.

The space
▌LIVING & DINING

⊙ Comfortable living room for relaxing with ample seating and entertainment options.

⊙ Fully stocked kitchen featuring cooking essentials, dishes, utensils, pots, pans, and a coffee maker.

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

▌BEDROOMS

⊙ Bedroom 1 – Luxurious king bed.

⊙ Bedroom 2 – Comfortable queen bed.

⊙ Bedroom 3 – Cozy queen bed.

⊙ Living Room – Sofa bed available for extra guests.

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

▌BATHROOMS

⊙ Bathroom 1 – Fully stocked, modern amenities.

⊙ Bathroom 2 – Stylish, clean, and convenient.

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

▌OUTDOOR & COMMUNITY FEATURES

⊙ Large private backyard with patio furniture, perfect for relaxation.

⊙ Free parking available on premises and street.

Guest access
⊙ You’ll have full access to the entire home, including all indoor and outdoor spaces.

⊙ Self check-in with a smart lock—your code will be sent before arrival.

Other things to note
Live Music Experience – By Request!
Want to make your Nashville trip even more unforgettable? 

We can arrange for a private acoustic set performed by a local Nashville recording artist right in the comfort of our home! The Artist will play a mix of your favorite covers and original songs. Just ask us how to book it!

We provide a starter supply of basic guest amenities to help you settle in comfortably. These are not restocked during your stay and include:

* 2 rolls of toilet paper per bathroom
* 2 rolls of paper towels
* 1 cleaning sponge
* A handful of K-Cups or a small bag of ground coffee

For longer stays or larger groups, we recommend bringing or purchasing any additional supplies you may need.

This property has specific local compliance requirements. Before check-in, guests must complete a signed rental agreement, identity verification, and a $1,000 - $1,500 security hold. The security hold is not a traditional security deposit, it is only a temporary pending authorization on your payment method.

As an optional alternative to the security hold, guests may purchase a non-refundable damage waiver through a third-party provider. The damage waiver is completely optional.

We make everything easy and secure by using Happy Guest, a convenient online platform that requires no app download or account setup. Through the secure guest portal, you can quickly complete your verification, view important property details, access check-in instructions, explore local Nashville recommendations, and take advantage of optional upgrades to enhance your stay.

Local guests within 25 miles must inquire before booking.
Smoke-free property violations incur a $150 fee.
Quiet hours after 10 PM for a restful experience.
